title: Algebra
description: Equations, powers, factoring, sequences and functions.

questions.explanation: Subtract 3 to get 2x = 8, then divide by 2: x = 4.
(−3) · (−3) = 9, because a negative times a negative is positive.
(a + b)(a + b) = a² + ab + ba + b² = a² + 2ab + b².
x² − 9 is a difference of squares: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).

questions.text: What is the slope of the line y = 3x − 5?
questions.explanation: In y = mx + b the slope is m, here 3.

questions.text: What are the roots of x² − 5x + 6 = 0?

questions.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: 3 + 4 = 7.
When dividing powers with the same base, subtract the exponents: 6 − 2 = 4.

questions.text: What is the discriminant of ax² + bx + c?
questions.explanation: The discriminant b² − 4ac decides how many real roots the quadratic has.

questions.text: If the discriminant of a quadratic is negative, the equation has:
questions.explanation: A negative discriminant means the square root in the formula is not real.
The absolute value is the distance from zero, which is never negative.
Add 7 to get 3x > 9, then divide by 3: x > 3.
Any non-zero number raised to the power 0 equals 1.

questions.text: What is the next term of 2, 5, 8, 11, ...?
questions.explanation: This arithmetic sequence adds 3 each time: 11 + 3 = 14.

questions.text: What is the sum of the first 10 positive integers?
Solve the system x + y = 10 and x − y = 4.
questions.explanation: Adding the equations gives 2x = 14, so x = 7 and y = 3.

questions.text: Which of these numbers is irrational?
questions.explanation: √2 cannot be written as a fraction of two integers; √16 = 4 is rational.
